== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Alread]]
* '''Event:''' [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Finals
* '''Finish:''' 3rd
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Revolution

Scrye magazine championship list as transcribed by Vermithrax (2013) from 1996–1998 Scrye issues. Spelling normalized to printed titles (Lars' Moisture Farm, Millennium Falcon, X-wing). Scrye did not star a starting location on this list.
